items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: a soldier came in that I knew. His name was Stanley Facey... So Facey sat down at the piano... I knew that Stanley was strong in the classical field but it was the first time I had ever heard him play jazz

ctx.x: One afternoon, we were jamming in the recreation hall and a soldier came in that I knew. His name was Stanley Facey and at one time he had been the piano accompanist for Eddie South who was known as the "Dark Angel" of the violin. There was another soldier with Facey who had a trumpet and they both had come tothe camp because they had heard that it was possible to blow there.

So Facey sat down at the piano and this trumpet player sat on the piano and they began to play along with the rest of us that were jamming, But the picture started to change real soon because these two cats started playing so much piano and trumpet that everyone else just wanted to listen. And the more they played, the better they seemed to get. I knew that Stanley was strong in the classical field but it was the first time I had ever heard him play jazz and he was wailing. His skirt was soaking wet and he looked…
